source: BK3 printed p.60 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.66 (program and circuit, 'Automatic' solution); relay light assignment printed p.59 = PDF p.65
note: No expect steps. The page states that a correct solution appears in the relay indicator lights at power-on and that pushbuttons 1-3 add positive information about Camille, Sara and Wanda, but it prints no relay-light state for the power-on solution and no resulting state for any pushbutton. Those states are derived (Step 7). No erratum covers p.60. ER-15 (p.58) corrects only the error expression for 'Sara should' and 'Camille could not'; the truth expression C + notS that the automatic solution is built on is unchanged. ER-17 (p.61, circuit representation of the Farmer program) does not apply. The script powers on, then presses and releases pushbuttons 1, 2 and 3 singly, as the printed procedure gives them ('To add positive information about a girl, push the appropriate pushbutton.'), so the trace records every state.
